text: But here's the problem. There is no bathroom. There is no toilet. You have two options. Option
one, squat over a bucket inside the house and hope nobody is watching. Spoiler alert,
everyone is watching. It's the same bucket everyone in your family uses,
maybe even the family goat once or twice. Option two, go outside and dump everything
straight onto the street, where every other person in town has done the exact same thing.
The air hits you like a wall. Heavy, wet, and smelling like something between a swamp
and death itself. People open their windows and pour their waste straight into the street.
If they were feeling polite, they'd shout, Gardeeloo! From the French for,
watch out for the water. Except it wasn't water. The result is a brown, bubbling river of
everything a human body can produce. It mixes with animal dung, rotting food, dead rats,
and rainwater. Until everything turns into sludge. When it rains, it floods. When it's hot,
it steams. Children play next to it, dogs eat from it, and it all flows downhill,
